item.description:
今天两条都指向同一件事：克隆型聚焦才是疗效的免疫学指纹——一条在 HIV 治愈模型里把 FcγR 与 CD8 克隆聚焦挂钩，一条在黑色素瘤血里用 TIGIT 把肿瘤反应性组库捞出来。 / Both papers converge on clonal focusing as the immunological fingerprint of efficacy: one ties FcγR engagement to CD8 clonal focusing in an HIV cure model, the other uses TIGIT to fish the tumor-reactive repertoire out of blood.

item.description:
今天最值钱的一条不是组库本身，而是把 V(D)J 克隆性搬到原位：在组织切片/液基样本上直接用成像读出浆细胞克隆，正好卡在我们的样本形态上。 / The most valuable item today is not repertoire itself but moving V(D)J clonality in situ: imaging reads plasma-cell clones directly in tissue sections — exactly our sample format.
